name: Citizens Union
lean_basis: Calls itself 'a nonpartisan and independent good-government group' (https://citizensunion.org/about/). No outside rating found; lean reflects its stated mission.

name: Common Cause New York
lean_basis: New York chapter of Common Cause, which describes 'our nonpartisan approach' (https://www.commoncause.org/new-york/about/) and does not endorse candidates. No outside rating found; lean reflects its stated mission.

name: The Municipal Art Society of New York (MAS)
lean_basis: Civic group founded, in its words, 'to work towards the creation of a livable city' (https://www.mas.org/about/); its positions here are about land use. No outside rating found; lean reflects its stated mission.

name: amNewYork editorial board
lean_basis: Not rated. The existing record contains no quoted ideological mission or usable outside rating. Its source: https://www.amny.com/.

name: Vital City (editors)
lean_basis: Not rated. The recorded description says: "a platform for ideas about how to improve civic life". This does not establish a position on the political scale. Source: https://www.vitalcitynyc.org/about.

lean_basis: An individual's stated vote, reported by The City; he leads the Citizens Budget Commission, which calls itself 'a nonpartisan, nonprofit civic think tank and watchdog' (https://cbcny.org/). No outside rating found; lean reflects its stated mission.
